announcements.title: We’re Aware of Current Issues and Working on Fixes
announcements.summary:
We’re aware that some users may be experiencing issues with Pixlume, including difficulties opening existing documents. Our team is actively investigating these issues and working on fixes to improve stability and reliability.
Thank you for your patience as we continue improving Pixlume.
announcements.body:
We’re Aware of Current Issues and Working on Fixes
We’re aware of several issues affecting the current version of Pixlume, and we’re actively working to address them.
One of the issues under investigation involves opening previously saved documents. Some users may experience difficulties accessing their existing projects.
Our development efforts are currently focused on improving application stability, document handling, and overall reliability across Pixlume Design and Pixlume Write.
We’re also continuing to improve the automatic update system to make future fixes and improvements easier to deliver.
What’s Next?
We’ll share additional information as fixes are completed and verified.
Thank you for your patience and continued support as we work to make Pixlume better.

releases.title: Pixlume 0.9.1 — Pixlume 0.9.1 Beta 1 — Features & Improvements
releases.description: Pixlume 0.9.1 Beta 1 introduces new templates for Design and Write, improved document creation and file opening, enhanced business card editing with individual card selection, a refined user interface, and important bug fixes for a smoother, more reliable creative experience.
releases.bodyMarkdown:
Pixlume 0.9.1 Beta 1 introduces new templates for Design and Write, improved document creation and file opening, enhanced business card editing with individual card selection, a refined user interface, and important bug fixes for a smoother, more reliable creative experience.

## New features
New Features — Pixlume 0.9.1 Beta 1

* 60 New Templates: Introducing 30 customizable templates for Pixlume Design and 30 for Pixlume Write.
* Template Gallery: Browse templates by category, search for designs, save favorites, and access recently used templates.
* New Document Selection: A redesigned experience for choosing document types, sizes, and presets when starting a project.
* Individual Business Card Editing: Select and customize individual cards within a full-page sheet, allowing different content in each slot.
* Independent Front and Back Designs: Create unique content for each side of a double-sided business card sheet.

## Improvements
Improvements — Pixlume 0.9.1 Beta 1

* Refined Pixlume Write Interface: Cleaner toolbars, improved alignment, and a more consistent workspace layout.
* Enhanced Business Card Layouts: Better card positioning, full-page sheet organization, and front-to-back layout handling.
* Improved Image Controls: More intuitive image placement, resizing, replacement, and fitting within card slots.
* More Reliable File Opening: Improved document routing and handling of unsupported or damaged files.
* Better Workspace Organization: Reduced duplicate interface elements and improved consistency between Design and Write.
* General Usability Enhancements: Refinements to existing editing workflows and navigation.

## Bug fixes
Bug Fixes — Pixlume 0.9.1 Beta 1

* Unexpected Blank Documents: Fixed an issue where opening files could create unnecessary blank documents or tabs.
* File Opening Errors: Improved handling of unsupported or damaged files to prevent incorrect editor behavior.
* Document Launch Issues: Fixed issues with files opening during application startup, ensuring they reach the correct workspace.
* Business Card Editing: Addressed issues affecting individual card selection and content editing.
* Business Card Layouts: Fixed layout inconsistencies affecting card placement and front/back sheet organization.
* User Interface Issues: Corrected duplicate interface elements and inconsistent toolbar layouts.
* General Bug Fixes: Addressed various reported usability and reliability issues across Pixlume Design and Write.

releases.title: Pixlume 0.8.0 — Pixlume 0.8.0 Beta 1 — The Creative Suite Preview
releases.description:
Your creativity. One workspace. Endless possibilities.

Introducing the first beta of Pixlume, a native creative suite for macOS that brings professional photo editing, graphic design, document creation, and PDF editing together in one seamless workspace.

With Pixlume Design and Pixlume Write, you can move between visual projects and documents without switching applications. Create layered designs, enhance images, format professional documents, and work with PDFs using powerful tools built around a unified, modern interface.

This first beta marks an exciting step toward our vision of making creative software more accessible, flexible, and enjoyable.
releases.bodyMarkdown:
Your creativity. One workspace. Endless possibilities.

Introducing the first beta of Pixlume, a native creative suite for macOS that brings professional photo editing, graphic design, document creation, and PDF editing together in one seamless workspace.

With Pixlume Design and Pixlume Write, you can move between visual projects and documents without switching applications. Create layered designs, enhance images, format professional documents, and work with PDFs using powerful tools built around a unified, modern interface.

This first beta marks an exciting step toward our vision of making creative software more accessible, flexible, and enjoyable.

## New features
Pixlume Design — Create Without Limits

* Layer-Based Editing: Create and manage complex compositions using layers, groups, masks, blending modes, and effects.
* Photoshop File Support: Import PSD and PSB documents, including supported layered content.
* Professional Image Editing: Work with brushes, selections, transformations, color adjustments, and image effects.
* Advanced Typography: Create and customize text with rich styling and artistic effects.
* Text Warp: Transform typography using 15 warp presets and adjustable distortion controls.
* Flexible Canvas: Create documents with custom dimensions, resolutions, orientations, and backgrounds.
* Image Export: Export designs to popular image formats.

Pixlume Write — Create Beyond Words

* Document Creation: Write and format documents with professional typography and page layouts.
* DOCX Compatibility: Import and export Microsoft Word documents with supported formatting.
* Tables and Images: Combine text, images, and structured content.
* Page Layout Tools: Customize page dimensions, orientation, margins, and document formatting.
* Artistic Text: Add creative typography and visual text effects.
* Duplex Card Designer: Create front-and-back cards with customizable dimensions, image fitting, and print layouts.
* PDF Export: Turn your documents into shareable PDF files.

Pixlume PDF — Take Control of Your Documents

* PDF Viewing: Open and navigate multipage PDF documents.
* Annotations: Highlight, underline, draw, and add notes.
* PDF Organization: Reorder, rotate, duplicate, extract, merge, and split pages.
* Forms and Signatures: Fill supported PDF forms and add signatures.
* Content Editing: Edit supported PDF text, images, and vector elements, with limitations for certain PDF structures.
* Export Tools: Save and export PDF content.

Creative Flow — Everything Connected

* Unified Workspace: Access Design, Write, and PDF tools in one application.
* Document Tabs: Switch between projects without opening separate editor windows.
* Recovery and Autosave: Help protect unfinished work with recovery backups.
* Recent Projects: Return to previously opened documents.
* Native macOS Experience: Familiar menus, keyboard shortcuts, and system integration.
* Consistent Interface: Shared controls and styling across creative workspaces.

## Improvements
Pixlume is currently in active development. Some features may be incomplete, behave unexpectedly, or change in future updates.

Known limitations may include printing, advanced document compatibility, and certain editing operations.

We recommend keeping backup copies of important projects while testing this beta.

Help Shape Pixlume

Your feedback helps make Pixlume better.

Found a bug? Have an idea for a new feature? Use the feedback tools on our website to share your experience.

Download Pixlume for Mac — Free Beta

Create beyond limits. Create with Pixlume.
